verdicts.quote: “Include an Authorization header in your request, with the value ‘Token YOUR_API_KEY’. Alternatively, you can pass the key as a URL query parameter named ‘apikey’.”
verdicts.reason: Docs show API-key auth for all endpoints; no OAuth/Bot token required for the REST API.

verdicts.quote: “Start with a 14-day trial that includes 100,000 free API credits.”
verdicts.reason: Trial is self-serve and issues an API key on signup, matching self_serve_trial.

verdicts.quote: “All four APIs are served from ‘https://api.seranking.com’ and use the same SE Ranking API key.”
verdicts.reason: Vendor OpenAPI repo documents four APIs (Data, Project, Local Marketing, SE Visible) covering many resources, i.e., broad.
MCP server is published on SE Ranking’s own docs/site and hosted at api.seranking.com, indicating it’s official.

verdicts.quote: “Usage is billed in API credits, and every current subscription plan includes a monthly credit allowance.”
verdicts.reason: Self-serve keys + full docs make it buildable now; caveats are paid credit/plan gating and documented rate limits.
